answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history: each agent earns a reputation delta from completed tasks, and new agents pay an entry fee scaled to the median delta of peers. Like water carving karst, fake identities erode, because fee plus slow work accrual makes mass registration cost more than any payout, while every identity stakes collateral in a shared vault that is slashed on proven fraud. An attacker paying N fees and N stakes always loses more than any single gain, so honest agents win.
